title: CP Manufacturing, Inc.
description:
[manufacturer] CP Manufacturing, Inc. — a San Diego-based industrial manufacturer of waste sorting and recycling equipment (MRF systems) operating since the 1970s under
the CP Group / CPG Sorting Technologies brand, with subsidiaries MSS Inc. (Nashville, TN), IMS Electronics Recycling, IMS Logistics, IMS Recycling Services,
Material Sales, HMM, and UK partner Recycleye.

The dataset includes complete server mirrors from HR, finance, engineering, legal, operations, and sales infrastructure, capturing the company's entire digital
footprint:

Sage/Epicor ERP accounting system for 8 entities (CPM, MSS, HMM, IMSR, IMSRE, MSIRE, CPGH, CP Global) with consolidated P&L showing $109.1M revenue, $10.2M net
income, and $12.1M EBITDA for FY2024, plus multi-year budgets (2021–2024), daily cash reports, and AR/AP data

~340 Social Security Numbers with full identity packages (name, DOB, health coverage status, premium amounts, tax withholdings) across 4 entities via ACA 1095-C
filings (2016–2022), biweekly payroll registers, 401(k) participant records, 10-year salary histories (2013–2023), and benefits administration across 5 carriers
(Anthem, Blue Shield, SIMNSA, UNUM, Western Dental)

<redacted>

<redacted>

Truist bank account details — routing number 053101121 and account number 1180009812409 for CP Manufacturing LLC, plus ACH payment batch files spanning August 2025
through August 2026

277+ GB of proprietary engineering IP — 22G of AutoCAD Electrical MRF designs with proprietary component catalogs (1.2G), 195G of Artec 3D scanner data for
manufactured equipment, 38G of CNC laser fabrication data (Amada LCG3015 AJ / FabriWin), PCB board designs (5 boards), SolidWorks Electrical templates, and Epicor
ERP Bill of Materials with proprietary part numbers

60+ customer contracts and 30+ NDAs with Republic Services, Waste Management, Recycleye/Nestlé, Cal-Waste, Balcones, Wasatch, and international partners, plus
Declaration Partners acquisition due diligence documents, competitor proposals (BHS, Machinex, MISTRAL), and a complete project green list

Privileged legal materials — active litigation subpoena (Hans Ouellet), Coastal Resources MWS settlement agreement with UCC1 financing statements,
separation/termination documents for named employees, restrictive covenant cease-and-desist letters, PIIAAs (invention assignment agreements), wage garnishment
orders, and corporate equity documents

200+ named job applicant resumes, 51 employee headshot photographs, 400+ vendor records with Tax IDs (including 3+ individual contractors with potential SSNs), and
a 7.8G Microsoft SQL Server backup (IMSROM) of undetermined contents
